Write the correct form. Two people → than. Three or more → the.
  1. 🧟 Alex’s zombie was (scary) than Leo’s ghost.
  2. 🎃 Mandy’s pumpkin was (big) than Chloe’s cat.
  3. 🤖 Jake’s robot was (creative) costume at the party.
  4. 💀 Tyler’s skeleton was (funny) costume of all.
  5. 🐈‍⬛ Chloe’s cat was (cute) than Alex’s zombie.
  6. 🧛 Bobby’s make-up was (good) than Alex’s make-up.
  7. 👻 Leo’s ghost was (easy) costume to make — just a sheet!

mandy’s script

read after listening
🔒

First finish and check the listening tasks.
Then you can read what Mandy said.

Now read what Mandy said. Listen again and read at the same time. 🎧👀 The orange words were the answers.

Hi Brittany, it’s Mandy. So... today Alex and I cleaned the gym. It took four hours! The gym was dirtier than a zoo. There was candy everywhere!

At first, Alex didn’t help. He sat on the floor and played games on his phone. I was so angry!

But then he found Leo’s candy under the stage, and he gave it back to Leo. That was nice.

After that, he worked really hard. He was faster than me! And he told me funny stories, so the time went quickly.

OK... maybe Alex isn’t the worst person in the world. But please don’t tell him I said that!

Mandy 🎃 · voice message
